strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Lets a persisted continue_development product decision admit the next objective task without caller-authored goal text.
Rust validates current product-decision and evidence fingerprints before deriving the next objective and creating the task.
TaskRecord and TaskStarted evidence expose bounded product-objective continuation provenance to headless callers without raw content.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with runtime_permission_enforcement and progress_visualization support.
answers.new_capability: A headless run-control caller can omit continuation_goal on product_continuation_derived_target and Rust derives one bounded next-objective task goal, identity fingerprint, and typed provenance from product-decision evidence.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M53/M57 product-continuation admission required caller-supplied continuation_goal, so the next objective remained caller-authored rather than runtime-derived.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: The product loop would still depend on an external scheduled prompt/controller to choose freeform next-objective text after continue_development.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M57 route admission/run, M58/M59 drive sequencing, and M60 recovery because this changes objective derivation at the product decision boundary.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. Existing headless.run.advance/drive derived product-continuation target and headless.continue_once admission behavior are extended; no JSON-RPC method is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It adds typed bounded provenance on TaskRecord and TaskStarted evidence, not a report, digest, history, readiness, preview, inspection, or dashboard surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Rust now generates the admission goal and product_objective_continuation_provenance from bounded product-decision metadata when continuation_goal is omitted on a derived route.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless automation can progress from a product decision to a next-objective Created task without freeform caller planning between objectives.
answers.milestone_progress: Establishes M61's first vertical slice and leaves any later journey binding as a separate capability only if it changes execution semantics.

Created continuation task carries product_objective_continuation_provenance with bounded source ids and fingerprints
TaskStarted evidence includes bounded derived objective and goal fingerprints without raw artifacts
Exact replay remains duplicate-free and mismatched caller-supplied goal/mode fails closed
Existing caller-supplied product-continuation admission and run behavior remains compatible
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test headless_run_drive_advances_product_continuation_routes_and_replays covers caller-goal-free derived admission from a persisted product-continuation route, deterministic runtime-generated goal, typed task provenance, bounded TaskStarted evidence, duplicate-free replay, and conflicting replay denial.

accepted_capability: Runtime-derived product objective continuation admission from continue_development evidence.
TaskRecord exposes bounded product_objective_continuation_provenance for headless inspection and replay.
behavior_evidence: Targeted Rust behavior test validates derived admission without caller-supplied goal text and replay identity preservation.
safety_boundary: Source decision must remain current continue_development with plan_next_phase and matching fingerprints.
Generated goal uses bounded labels and fingerprints only.
Admission creates a Created task only; it does not automatically run provider, tools, shell, git, network, services, or workspace mutation.
Ledger and RPC output avoid raw prompts, provider responses, file content, diffs, command output, paths, credentials, and secrets.
non_goals: No new report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, preview, inspection, dashboard, or summary wrapper.
No automatic journey execution or task.run beyond existing explicit drive budget behavior.
No replacement of caller-supplied product-continuation admission paths.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected keeping continuation_goal mandatory for derived admission because that preserves caller-owned objective selection.
Rejected adding a planning/readiness report because it would not create an executable task.
Rejected combining this phase with full objective journey binding because that would mix admission and execution semantics.
technical_debt: M61.2 may bind the runtime-derived objective task into a broader journey only if it adds a distinct capability.
The existing product-continuation route names remain broad but sufficient for this vertical slice.
next_capability_rationale: After M61.1, evaluate whether runtime-derived objective tasks can be admitted into the objective journey without caller-authored objective context.
